title: Explain build item patterns and selected files
goal: Report include, exclude and remove patterns alongside expanded items when diagnosing why a build selected a file.

selectionNotes: Authored include/exclude/remove patterns are printed separately from expanded files; private/draft fixtures are excluded. On SDK11 an unset MSBuildProvideItemGlobs supplies no patterns.
Target 11 only; no older-target/newer-SDK or Framework MSBuild execution claim.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Managed consumer target exercised on Windows.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Intended language mode of the original managed consumer; the XML glob configuration itself is language-neutral.

platforms: Windows x64 measured; other platforms not exercised.
prerequisites: Select an absolute compatible dotnet executable and inspect global.json and inherited build configuration.
constraints: Unevaluated patterns are not the expanded file list or a complete explanation of every build condition.
The older XmlPeek example reads one authored file; it does not reconstruct the import graph.
Target 11 only; .NET 10 sources are previous-release comparisons, not an additional historical foundation or a tested older-target route.
Playbook only serves embedded guidance. No provisioning, registry push, telemetry transmission or consumer mutation is performed by consulting it.
stabilityLimitations: Focused Windows authored-versus-expanded controls only; the older XmlPeek diagnostic reads one authored file. No complete imported graph or Framework MSBuild execution is claimed.

sources.title: MSBuild RC1 archive tasks and item globs

evidence.scope: Official-source review and original sample authoring only. SDK/target/language values describe intended inputs, not observed compilation. No compilation, cross-compilation, mock, execution, artifact or installed MCP proof.
